resumeText:
Rohan Mehta | Mumbai | rohan.mehta@example.com

SUMMARY
Risk leader with 15 years in retail lending at NBFCs and a bank.

EXPERIENCE
VP - Risk Management, Sahyadri Finance (NBFC, upper layer), Mumbai (2019 - present)
- Run the risk appetite framework and limits approved by the board.
- Lead credit portfolio monitoring with early warning signals and vintage analysis.
- Own the application scorecard development cycle with the analytics team.
- Set up RCSA and key risk indicators for branches and collections.
- Keep the company compliant with scale based regulation and RBI master directions.
- Sign off regulatory returns and RBI inspection responses.
- Present risk packs to the board risk committee each quarter.
- Managed a team of 18 across credit and operational risk.
- Use stakeholder communication with business, collections and the CEO.

Senior Manager - Credit Risk, Lakeview Bank, Mumbai (2013 - 2019)
- Built portfolio MIS for personal loans.

Credit Analyst, Konkan Capital, Pune (2011 - 2013)

EDUCATION
MBA Finance, Jamnalal Bajaj Institute, 2011
BCom, University of Mumbai, 2009
